description: Get an interview's synthesised report (summary, themes, recommendations, per-question rollup), plus `usability` (UMUX or UMUX-Lite scores when asked). Poll after launch_interview until report_status is completed or failed; report is null until generated.

interview_id.description: Interview UUID, from list_interviews or create_interview.

name: get_interview_report

report.description: The current report, or null before the first synthesis completes.

report_status.description: Report synthesis status, e.g. idle, queued, running, completed or failed.

ci95.description: 95% confidence interval for the mean, null under two respondents.

grade.description: Sauro-Lewis curved grade, F to A+.

tone.description: positive, or negative when agreement counts against.

participants.description: Each participant who answered, for get_interview_participant.

raw_score.description: Mean score on the questionnaire's own 0 to 100 scale.

respondents.description: Participants whose answers could be scored.

scale.description: The questionnaire answered: umux or umux_lite.

score.description: Mean score on the SUS scale, 0 to 100. UMUX is read as is; UMUX-Lite is adjusted (0.65 x raw + 22.9). 68 is average.

vs_benchmark.description: Points above (positive) or below the average of 68.

usability.description: Usability questionnaire results for the latest round, or null when the interview does not ask one or nobody has answered yet.

title: Get interview report
